title: Largest Color Value in a Directed Graph
goal: Find the greatest count of one color on a directed path, or -1 if a cycle exists.
strategy: Topological traversal ensures all incoming path counts are available. Propagate one best count per color to successors; vertices left unprocessed reveal a cycle.
